out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical quaternary ammonia sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit. Follow-up will be conducted within 10 days.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the dish sink being used to store scouring pads.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Person in charge removed scouring pads.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: white rice (123F), cooked chicken (122F) in 2 door stacked warmer.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Person in charge will used items for the remainder of 4 hours, at the end of which, all remaining portions will be discarded.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: corn on the cob and cut steak observed being hot held below 135F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC stated the foods had been prepared less than 2 hours prior- PIC removed the foods to be reheated to 165F. Verify temperatures of foods prior to placing in hot boxes for transport and/or holding.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: pico de gallo, sour cream, ice cream mix observed at 45-56F in 2 Dr prep refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Foods were discarded.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials (soap+water) are not properly labeled with a common name.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 door prep refrigerator holding at about 60F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.
